gloss: registering a marriage; entering a family register

definitions.gloss: registering a marriage; entering a family register
definitions.explanation: The act of submitting a marriage registration to the local government office, which legally establishes the marriage. In everyday use, often synonymous with getting legally married.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}{入籍|にゅうせき}しました。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}の{前|まえ}に{入籍|にゅうせき}を{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: We completed the marriage registration before the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{記念日|きねんび}に{合|あ}わせて{入籍|にゅうせき}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: We plan to register our marriage on our anniversary.

notes: Literally means 'entering the family register' ({戸籍|こせき}). In Japan, a marriage becomes legally valid when the {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ} (marriage registration form) is submitted to the {役所|やくしょ} (government office), not when a ceremony is held. Common collocations: {入籍|にゅうせき}する (to register a marriage), {入籍届|にゅうせきとどけ} (registration form), {入籍日|にゅうせきび} (registration date). Many couples choose a meaningful date for {入籍|にゅうせき}, such as a holiday or anniversary. Often used with する as a verb.
